name: Advanced Thermodynamics
description: Review of basic fundamentals, closed system and open system formulations, laws of thermodynamics, the maximum entropy principle, concept of equations of state, ideal gas, van der Waals equations and other variants, compressibility, maximum work theorem, availability, exergy, extremum principles for thermodynamic potentials and relationships for compressible, elastic, electric and magnetic systems, stability conditions of potentials and phase transitions, conditions of equilibrium and stability of multicomponent systems, entropy of mixing, chemical potential, mixtures, thermodynamics of reactive mixtures and electrochemical systems.
